channel.title: Clockspring 3D
channel.description:
Clockspring3D is all about finding inspration and driving creativity, especially in the context of 3D printing and design.

There is a tendency to think of 3D printers as tools whose existence needs to be justified, rather than as a means of creative expression!  Plenty of material exists around finding personal creative style in traditional media, but not so much in this largely-technical realm.

videos.t: Chunky Ring Vase - 3D Print Inspiration and Design!
videos.desc:
Going from inspiration to execution on a chunky 3D print!  Share the fun of designing and printing gratuitously robust printed parts just because they're awesome.  Overengineering never felt so good!  3D printing is more than just a tool, it's a vast highway of creative exploration!

STL files for the vase: https://www.myminifactory.com/object/3d-print-chunky-ring-vase-77170
Glass artwork courtesy of https://sarah-dawson.com/

videos.t: Make Video Lights from Ikea Lamps with 3D Printing!
videos.desc:
Let's take a cheap Ikea lamp and convert it for use as continuous lighting for video by creating a 3D printed clamp.  We look at the inspiration, sketching out a design, implementation using Tinkercad, and as always, talk about inspiration and creativity in 3D printing.  I also ramble a bit about what I've been doing since the last video in terms of creative exploration.  Spoiler: I've been 3D printing things.

Link to the STL files for the adaptor:
https://www.myminifactory.com/object/3d-print-77756

As always, find me on Twitter at @clockspring3D
And on MyMiniFactory at https://www.myminifac

By request, here's my brain dump on photography and 3D printing!  Simple and streamlined photography workflow for getting great and consistent results with minimum effort - and with minimal equipment!  Every print you do is an opportunity to refine your photography and style, so get to it!

videos.t: Making Doodle Tops - 3D Printing Inspiration and Creativity
videos.desc:
Let's design 3D printed spinning tops that draw squiggly lines!  We'll talk about concepts, do a rough design, then throw the design out the window during implementation in TinkerCad!  Never fear, though, the final design will work great!  As always, we're most interested in exploring ideas and finding creative inspiration!

The download for the Doodle Top model can be found here:
https://www.myminifactory.com/object/3d-print-doodle-tops-79634

However!  You should be able to make it yourself by following the video, and you should do that!  Make it better!
